title: The Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) used to perform ablution upon every prayer
hadeeth: ‘Amr ibn ‘Āmir related that Anas ibn Mālik reported: The Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) used to perform ablution upon every prayer. I asked: "What did you guys use to do?" He said: "Ablution would remain valid for any of us until he broke it."
explanation:
The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) used to perform ablution for every obligatory prayer, even if his ablution was not broken. This is to attain the reward and merit.

It is permissible to perform more than one obligatory prayer with one ablution, so long as the ablution remains valid.
hints: The Prophet (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) used to perform ablution upon every prayer, seeking perfection.
It is recommended to perform ablution for every prayer.
It is permissible to offer more than one prayer with one ablution.
hadeeth_intro: ‘Amr ibn ‘Āmir related that Anas ibn Mālik reported:
hadeeth_ar: عن عَمْرُو بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ ‌أَنَس بن مالك قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، قُلْتُ: كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ؟ قَالَ: يُجْزِئُ أَحَدَنَا الْوُضُوءُ مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ.
hadeeth_intro_ar: عن عَمْرُو بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ ‌أَنَس بن مالك قَالَ:
explanation_ar:
كان النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يتوضأ لكلِّ صلاةٍ مفروضةٍ وإنْ لم يَنْتَقِضْ وضوؤُه؛ وذلك لتحصيل الأجر والفضل.

ويجوز أن يُصلِّي أكثرَ مِن صلاةٍ مفروضةٍ بوضوء واحد ما دام على وضوئه.
hints_ar: أكثرُ فِعْلِ النبيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم هو الوضوء لكل صلاة؛ طلبًا للأكمل.
جواز تأدية أكثر من صلاة بوضوء واحد.
